name: Aether
description: A frosted-glass design system inspired by Apple's light material language. Translucent pill surfaces float over a soft pearl backdrop, anchored by a charcoal accent and quiet refracted highlights.
concept: Aether translates Apple-style glass material into a reusable token language. Every interactive surface is a thin translucent pane with an inset highlight bevel, a hairline border, and a soft ambient shadow. Pill geometry, a cool pearl background, and a charcoal icon-chip accent create a calm, optical, premium feel.

palette.name: Pearl
palette.role: Main page background — cool, soft, Apple-adjacent light surface

palette.name: Glass
palette.role: Translucent surface fill at low alpha for glass panes and cards

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary text, charcoal icon chips, and primary action anchor

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary text, muted labels, and subdued iconography

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Tertiary text, placeholders, and inactive states

palette.name: System Blue
palette.role: Focus rings, links, and accent highlights

palette.name: Aurora
palette.role: Subtle refraction wash behind hero glass surfaces

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Low-alpha borders and edge containment at 8 percent

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Numeric chips, keyboard keys, and metadata labels

iconPack.name: Lucide
iconPack.usage: Used for interface, action, and feature icons across buttons, inputs, tabs, the command dock, and the landing preview. Stroked at 1.75 with currentColor.
